recipes.name: Greek yogurt parfait with berries and granola
steps: Stir the whey into the yogurt until smooth.
Layer the yogurt with the berries in a bowl or jar.
Top with the granola and eat right away.

recipes.name: Almond yogurt parfait with berries and oats
steps: Stir the whey into the yogurt until smooth.
Layer the yogurt with the berries in a bowl or jar.
Top with the granola and eat right away.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt parfait with berries and oats
steps: Stir the whey into the yogurt until smooth.
Layer the yogurt with the berries in a bowl or jar.
Top with the granola and eat right away.

recipes.name: Protein oatmeal with peanut butter and banana
steps: Cook the oats in water on the stove or in the microwave until thick.
Let it cool for a minute, then stir in the whey until smooth.
Top with sliced banana and the peanut butter.

recipes.name: Vegan protein oatmeal with peanut butter and banana
steps: Cook the oats in water on the stove or in the microwave until thick.
Let it cool for a minute, then stir in the whey until smooth.
Top with sliced banana and the peanut butter.

recipes.name: Protein quinoa porridge with peanut butter and banana
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in water for 15 minutes until soft.
Let it cool for a minute, then stir in the whey until smooth.
Top with sliced banana and the peanut butter.

recipes.name: Egg white and veggie scramble with toast
steps: Heat the oil in a pan and cook the peppers and onions until soft.
Pour in the egg whites and stir gently until just set.
Toast the bread and serve it alongside the scramble.

recipes.name: Egg and veggie scramble with toast
steps: Heat the oil in a pan and cook the peppers and onions until soft.
Pour in the egg whites and stir gently until just set.
Toast the bread and serve it alongside the scramble.

recipes.name: Tofu and veggie scramble with toast
steps: Heat the oil in a pan and cook the peppers and onions until soft.
Crumble in the tofu and cook until hot and lightly browned.
Toast the bread and serve it alongside the scramble.

recipes.name: Egg white and veggie scramble with potatoes
steps: Dice the potatoes and microwave them for 4 minutes until tender.
Heat the oil in a pan and brown the potatoes with the peppers and onions.
Pour in the egg whites and stir gently until just set.

recipes.name: Protein pancakes with berries
steps: Whisk the pancake mix, eggs and whey with a splash of water into a thick batter.
Cook small pancakes in a hot nonstick pan for 2 minutes a side.
Warm the berries in the microwave and spoon them over the top.

recipes.name: Vegan banana oat pancakes with berries
steps: Blend the oats, banana and pea protein with a splash of water into a thick batter.
Cook small pancakes in a hot nonstick pan for 3 minutes a side.
Warm the berries in the microwave and spoon them over the top.

recipes.name: Oat protein pancakes with berries
steps: Blend the oats, eggs and whey with a splash of water into a thick batter.
Cook small pancakes in a hot nonstick pan for 2 minutes a side.
Warm the berries in the microwave and spoon them over the top.

recipes.name: Egg and avocado breakfast wrap
steps: Whisk the eggs and egg whites and scramble them in a hot pan.
Warm the tortilla for 20 seconds in the pan or microwave.
Fill with the eggs, sliced avocado and salsa, then roll it up.

recipes.name: Tofu and avocado breakfast wrap
steps: Crumble the tofu into a hot pan and cook until lightly browned.
Warm the tortilla for 20 seconds in the pan or microwave.
Fill with the tofu, sliced avocado and salsa, then roll it up.

recipes.name: Egg and avocado breakfast tacos
steps: Whisk the eggs and egg whites and scramble them in a hot pan.
Warm the tortilla for 20 seconds in the pan or microwave.
Fill with the eggs, sliced avocado and salsa, then roll it up.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese bowl with fruit and honey
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with the berries and sliced banana.
Drizzle the honey over the top.

recipes.name: Vegan protein yogurt bowl with fruit and peanut butter
steps: Stir the pea protein into the yogurt until smooth.
Top with the berries and sliced banana.
Spoon the peanut butter over the top.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese toast with berries and honey
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread the cottage cheese over the toast and top with the berries.
Drizzle the honey over the top.

recipes.name: Chicken caesar wrap
steps: Slice the chicken thin and cook it in a hot pan until no longer pink.
Chop the romaine and toss it with the dressing and parmesan.
Pile the chicken and salad onto the tortilla and roll it up.

recipes.name: Turkey caesar wrap
steps: Chop the romaine and toss it with the dressing and parmesan.
Warm the tortilla for 20 seconds in the microwave.
Layer the turkey and salad onto the tortilla and roll it up.

recipes.name: Chicken caesar bowl with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Slice the chicken thin and cook it in a hot pan until no longer pink.
Chop the romaine and toss it with the dressing and parmesan.
Serve the chicken and salad over the rice.

recipes.name: Southwest chicken wrap
steps: Dice the chicken, toss it with the taco seasoning and cook it in a hot pan.
Warm the black beans and the tortilla.
Fill the tortilla with the chicken, beans, salsa and sliced avocado, then roll it up.

recipes.name: Southwest tofu wrap
steps: Dice the chicken, toss it with the taco seasoning and cook it in a hot pan.
Warm the black beans and the tortilla.
Fill the tortilla with the chicken, beans, salsa and sliced avocado, then roll it up.

recipes.name: Southwest chicken tacos
steps: Dice the chicken, toss it with the taco seasoning and cook it in a hot pan.
Warm the black beans and the tortillas.
Fill the tortillas with the chicken, beans, salsa and sliced avocado.

recipes.name: Chicken burrito bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Dice the chicken, toss it with the taco seasoning and cook it in a hot pan.
Warm the black beans.
Build the bowl with rice, chicken, beans, salsa and sliced avocado.

recipes.name: Tofu burrito bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Dice the chicken, toss it with the taco seasoning and cook it in a hot pan.
Warm the black beans.
Build the bowl with rice, chicken, beans, salsa and sliced avocado.

recipes.name: Chicken burrito bowl with quinoa
steps: Cook the rice.
Dice the chicken, toss it with the taco seasoning and cook it in a hot pan.
Warm the black beans.
Build the bowl with rice, chicken, beans, salsa and sliced avocado.

recipes.name: Turkey and avocado sandwich on whole wheat
steps: Toast the bread and spread it with the hummus.
Slice the avocado and tomato.
Stack the turkey, avocado and tomato between the slices.

recipes.name: Tempeh and avocado sandwich on whole wheat
steps: Slice the tempeh into thin slabs and pan sear them in a hot pan until golden.
Toast the bread and spread it with the hummus.
Stack the tempeh, sliced avocado and tomato between the slices.

recipes.name: Turkey and avocado wrap
steps: Spread the hummus over the tortilla.
Slice the avocado and tomato.
Layer the turkey, avocado and tomato on top and roll it up.

recipes.name: Tuna salad wrap
steps: Drain the tuna and mash it with the avocado and hummus.
Chop the romaine.
Spread the tuna salad over the tortilla, add the romaine and roll it up.

recipes.name: Chicken salad wrap
steps: Drain the tuna and mash it with the avocado and hummus.
Chop the romaine.
Spread the tuna salad over the tortilla, add the romaine and roll it up.

recipes.name: Tuna and avocado rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Drain the tuna and mash it with the avocado and hummus.
Serve the tuna salad over the rice with the chopped romaine.

recipes.name: Mediterranean chicken bowl with tzatziki
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in water for 15 minutes until soft.
Dice the chicken and cook it in the oil until no longer pink.
Chop the cucumber and tomato.
Build the bowl with quinoa, chicken, vegetables and a spoon of tzatziki.

recipes.name: Mediterranean tofu bowl with hummus
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in water for 15 minutes until soft.
Dice the chicken and cook it in the oil until no longer pink.
Chop the cucumber and tomato.
Build the bowl with quinoa, chicken, vegetables and a spoon of tzatziki.

recipes.name: Mediterranean chicken wrap with tzatziki
steps: Dice the chicken and cook it in the oil until no longer pink.
Chop the cucumber and tomato.
Spread the tzatziki over the tortilla, add the chicken and vegetables and roll it up.

recipes.name: Turkey taco bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the turkey in a hot pan and stir in the taco seasoning.
Warm the black beans.
Build the bowl with rice, turkey, beans and salsa.

recipes.name: Lentil taco bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the turkey in a hot pan and stir in the taco seasoning.
Warm the black beans.
Build the bowl with rice, turkey, beans and salsa.

recipes.name: Turkey tacos
steps: Brown the turkey in a hot pan and stir in the taco seasoning.
Warm the black beans and the tortillas.
Fill the tortillas with the turkey, beans and salsa.

recipes.name: Teriyaki chicken and broccoli rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Dice the chicken and cook it in the oil until browned.
Add the broccoli and teriyaki sauce and cook until the broccoli is hot and the sauce is sticky.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Teriyaki tofu and broccoli rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Dice the chicken and cook it in the oil until browned.
Add the broccoli and teriyaki sauce and cook until the broccoli is hot and the sauce is sticky.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Teriyaki chicken and broccoli quinoa bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Dice the chicken and cook it in the oil until browned.
Add the broccoli and teriyaki sauce and cook until the broccoli is hot and the sauce is sticky.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Chicken fajita bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Slice the chicken into strips and toss it with the taco seasoning.
Cook the chicken in the oil over high heat, then add the peppers and onions and cook until charred.
Serve over the rice with the salsa.

recipes.name: Shrimp fajita bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Slice the chicken into strips and toss it with the taco seasoning.
Cook the chicken in the oil over high heat, then add the peppers and onions and cook until charred.
Serve over the rice with the salsa.

recipes.name: Chicken fajitas with flour tortillas
steps: Slice the chicken into strips and toss it with the taco seasoning.
Cook the chicken in the oil over high heat, then add the peppers and onions and cook until charred.
Warm the tortillas and fill them with the chicken, vegetables and salsa.

recipes.name: Sheet pan chicken with sweet potato and broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and cube the sweet potato.
Toss the sweet potato with half the oil on a sheet pan and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken and broccoli tossed in the rest of the oil and roast 15 minutes more.

recipes.name: Sheet pan tofu with sweet potato and broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F, cube the sweet potato and press and cube the tofu.
Toss the sweet potato with half the oil on a sheet pan and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the tofu and broccoli tossed in the rest of the oil and roast 15 minutes more.

recipes.name: Sheet pan chicken with potatoes and broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and cube the sweet potato.
Toss the sweet potato with half the oil on a sheet pan and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken and broccoli tossed in the rest of the oil and roast 15 minutes more.

recipes.name: Turkey chili
steps: Chop the onion and pepper and cook them in a pot until soft.
Add the turkey and brown it, then stir in the taco seasoning.
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Lentil chili
steps: Chop the onion and pepper and cook them in a pot until soft.
Stir in the taco seasoning, lentils, tomatoes and two cups of water.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils are tender, then add the beans and heat through.

recipes.name: Turkey chili over a baked potato
steps: Prick the potato and microwave it for 8 minutes until soft.
Chop the onion and pepper and cook them in a pot until soft.
Add the turkey and brown it, then stir in the taco seasoning and tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Split the potato and spoon the chili over it.

recipes.name: Pesto chicken pasta
steps: Boil the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Dice the chicken and cook it in a hot pan until no longer pink.
Toss the pasta, broccoli and chicken with the pesto and top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Pesto shrimp pasta
steps: Boil the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Dice the chicken and cook it in a hot pan until no longer pink.
Toss the pasta, broccoli and chicken with the pesto and top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Gluten free pesto chicken pasta
steps: Boil the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Dice the chicken and cook it in a hot pan until no longer pink.
Toss the pasta, broccoli and chicken with the pesto and top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Turkey meatballs with whole wheat spaghetti
steps: Mix the turkey with the breadcrumbs, egg and half the parmesan and roll into meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in a pan, add the marinara and simmer for 12 minutes.
Boil the spaghetti and drain.
Serve the meatballs and sauce over the spaghetti with the rest of the parmesan.

recipes.name: Beef meatballs with whole wheat spaghetti
steps: Mix the turkey with the breadcrumbs, egg and half the parmesan and roll into meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in a pan, add the marinara and simmer for 12 minutes.
Boil the spaghetti and drain.
Serve the meatballs and sauce over the spaghetti with the rest of the parmesan.

recipes.name: Turkey meatballs with gluten free spaghetti
steps: Mix the turkey with the breadcrumbs, egg and half the parmesan and roll into meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in a pan, add the marinara and simmer for 12 minutes.
Boil the spaghetti and drain.
Serve the meatballs and sauce over the spaghetti with the rest of the parmesan.

recipes.name: Chicken stir-fry with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Slice the chicken thin and cook it in the oil over high heat until browned.
Add the vegetables and stir fry until hot, then add the soy sauce.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Tofu stir-fry with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Slice the chicken thin and cook it in the oil over high heat until browned.
Add the vegetables and stir fry until hot, then add the soy sauce.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Chicken stir-fry noodles
steps: Boil the spaghetti and drain.
Slice the chicken thin and cook it in the oil over high heat until browned.
Add the vegetables and stir fry until hot, then add the soy sauce.
Toss the noodles through the pan and serve.

recipes.name: Healthier chicken parmesan
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and flatten the chicken to an even thickness.
Dip the chicken in the beaten egg, then coat it in the breadcrumbs.
Bake on a rack for 18 minutes, then top with marinara and mozzarella and bake 5 minutes more.
Steam the broccoli and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Healthier tofu parmesan
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F, press the tofu and slice it into thick slabs.
Dip the tofu in the beaten egg, then coat it in the breadcrumbs.
Bake on a rack for 20 minutes, then top with marinara and mozzarella and bake 5 minutes more.
Steam the broccoli and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Healthier chicken parmesan with oat crust
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F, flatten the chicken and pulse the oats into coarse crumbs.
Dip the chicken in the beaten egg, then coat it in the oat crumbs.
Bake on a rack for 18 minutes, then top with marinara and mozzarella and bake 5 minutes more.
Steam the broccoli and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Turkey burgers with sweet potato wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F, cut the sweet potato into wedges, toss with the oil and roast for 25 minutes.
Shape the turkey into two patties and cook them in a hot pan for 5 minutes a side.
Serve the patties on the bun with the romaine and the wedges on the side.

recipes.name: Tempeh burgers with sweet potato wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F, cut the sweet potato into wedges, toss with the oil and roast for 25 minutes.
Slice the tempeh into two thick slabs and pan sear them for 4 minutes a side until golden.
Serve the tempeh on the bun with the romaine and the wedges on the side.

recipes.name: Bunless turkey burgers with sweet potato wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F, cut the sweet potato into wedges, toss with the oil and roast for 25 minutes.
Shape the turkey into two patties and cook them in a hot pan for 5 minutes a side.
Serve the patties over the romaine with the wedges on the side.

recipes.name: Ground turkey lettuce wraps
steps: Brown the turkey in the oil in a hot pan.
Grate the carrot and add it with the edamame and soy sauce, then cook until hot.
Separate the romaine leaves and spoon the filling into them.

recipes.name: Tofu lettuce wraps
steps: Crumble the tofu into the oil in a hot pan and cook until lightly browned.
Grate the carrot and add it with the edamame and soy sauce, then cook until hot.
Separate the romaine leaves and spoon the filling into them.

recipes.name: Ground turkey and edamame rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the turkey in the oil in a hot pan.
Grate the carrot and add it with the edamame and soy sauce, then cook until hot.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.name: BBQ chicken with roasted vegetables and rice
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and roast the chicken on a sheet pan for 20 minutes.
Brush the chicken with the barbecue sauce, add the vegetables tossed in the oil and roast 10 minutes more.
Cook the rice and serve everything over it.

recipes.name: BBQ pork loin with roasted vegetables and rice
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and roast the chicken on a sheet pan for 20 minutes.
Brush the chicken with the barbecue sauce, add the vegetables tossed in the oil and roast 10 minutes more.
Cook the rice and serve everything over it.

recipes.name: BBQ chicken with roasted vegetables and potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F, cube the potatoes and toss them in the oil on a sheet pan with the chicken.
Roast for 20 minutes.
Brush the chicken with the barbecue sauce, add the vegetables and roast 10 minutes more.

recipes.name: Buffalo chicken bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Dice the chicken and cook it in a hot pan until browned, then toss with the buffalo sauce.
Chop the romaine, grate the carrot and slice the avocado.
Build the bowl with rice, chicken and the vegetables.

recipes.name: Buffalo tempeh bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Dice the chicken and cook it in a hot pan until browned, then toss with the buffalo sauce.
Chop the romaine, grate the carrot and slice the avocado.
Build the bowl with rice, chicken and the vegetables.

recipes.name: Buffalo chicken and sweet potato bowl
steps: Cube the sweet potato and microwave it for 6 minutes until tender.
Dice the chicken and cook it in a hot pan until browned, then toss with the buffalo sauce.
Chop the romaine, grate the carrot and slice the avocado.
Build the bowl with sweet potato, chicken and the vegetables.

recipes.name: Shrimp and veggie stir-fry
steps: Cook the rice.
Cook the vegetables and edamame in the oil over high heat until hot.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, then add the soy sauce.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Pork and veggie stir-fry
steps: Cook the rice.
Slice the pork thin and cook it in the oil over high heat until browned.
Add the vegetables and edamame and stir fry until hot, then add the soy sauce.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Shrimp and veggie stir-fry with brown rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Cook the vegetables and edamame in the oil over high heat until hot.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, then add the soy sauce.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Salmon with rice and asparagus
steps: Cook the rice.
Heat the oven to 400 F and lay the salmon and asparagus on a sheet pan drizzled with the oil.
Roast for 15 minutes until the salmon flakes.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Tilapia with rice and asparagus
steps: Cook the rice.
Heat the oven to 400 F and lay the salmon and asparagus on a sheet pan drizzled with the oil.
Roast for 15 minutes until the salmon flakes.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Salmon with sweet potato and asparagus
steps: Heat the oven to 400 F, cube the sweet potato, toss it with half the oil and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the salmon and asparagus drizzled with the rest of the oil.
Roast for 15 minutes more until the salmon flakes.
